skill_interface: eleven gate evidence states in; preparation decision out
source_policy: Official KOFPI procedure grounds process claims; project gate policy grounds only internal preparation controls.
tool_policy: No payment, contract, registry, tax, legal, certification, retirement, or public-claim tool.
guardrail: STOP outranks REVIEW; PROCEED means evidence preparation only.
validation_rule: Exactly G1-G11 with PRESENT, MISSING, UNKNOWN, or NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON states.
trace_policy: Record every gate input, policy verdict, and missing evidence item.
approval_policy: Named humans and official institutions retain every external decision and action.
invocation_contract: One immutable evidence snapshot per run; retries are new runs.
release_policy: Gate-policy or handler changes require a new fingerprint and full fixture regression.
